title: RSH v3.0.0: Machine-Checked Robitaille–Slade Helix Geometry and Deterministic Evidence
description: RSH v3.0.0 introduces RSH-FORMAL-V1, a Lean 4 formal theorem surface for exact rational inversive-witness geometry, 32-bit/21-trit address capacity, Frenet–Serret orthonormal-constraint compatibility, exact midpoint translation, and monotone constitutional admission logic.
